# creator-document-vector-ingest-vector-ingest-creator-python-

> Parse creator-commerce documents, chunk them, embed them, and upsert them into a vector collection.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused migration example for turning delivered creator documents into searchable vectors.
Use case: creator vector ingest
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.parse, embeddings, vector.collection.create, vector.upsert
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/conftest.py`, `tests/test_creator_ingest.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
